comment: nhlua.c nhl_loadlua() running a level program reached through a directory part. #wizloaddes './minefill.lua' (a dot, so wiz_load_splua() appends nothing) opens minefill.lua in the playground and load_special() builds a Mines filler level; #wizloadlua 'save/../oracle.lua' passes through save/ and load_lua() runs the Oracle's des.* calls on the current level without post-processing. The chunk names keep the typed names. Exact-case names, so both hosts open the files. Seed, date, human Barbarian and names chosen independently.
